anti_leakage_boundary: Static features use only P0 hand and candidate declaration. Points samples and make outcomes are offline labels, not live bidding features.

larger_run_recommendation.auction_context: Add real or simulated auction histories when available: bidder seat, partner/opponent bids, current high bid, score, pass/bid alternatives.
larger_run_recommendation.hands: >=1000 arbitrary generated hands or auction-policy hands
larger_run_recommendation.primary_test: Within identical seed/hand/decl/current_high groups, compare minimum_winning_bid against higher actual_bid rows; report p_make and mark_swing deltas by margin and static risk bucket.
larger_run_recommendation.samples_per_decl: >=200 for screening, >=500 for narrower claim promotion

purpose: Generate auction-aware candidate bid rows that separate static hand/declaration strength from bid-level margin quality.
